(a)   Acquisition of additional interest in subsidiaries - 2025/26
During the year, the Group acquired additional equity interests in certain subsidiaries from non-controlling shareholders.
As the Group already held control over these entities, the transactions were accounted for as equity transactions in
accordance with SLFRS 10 – Consolidated Financial Statements. The carrying amounts of the non-controlling interests
were adjusted to reflect the change in ownership, with the difference between the consideration paid and the adjustment
to NCI recognised directly in equity. Details of the acquisitions are as follows:

49   RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
The Group entities carried out transactions in the ordinary course of its business with the parties who are defined as
related parties in Sri Lanka Accounting standard LKAS - 24 “Related party disclosures”, the details of which are reported
below.
Parent and ultimate controlling party
Bukit Darah PLC is the ultimate parent and controlling entity of Carson Cumberbatch PLC.
Terms and conditions of transactions with related parties
The Group entities carried out transactions in the ordinary course of business with its related entities. The list of Directors
at each of the subsidiaries, have been disclosed in the Group Directorate under the Supplementary Information section of
the Annual Report.

49   RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS (Contd.)
(b)   Letter of comfort provided
Carson Cumberbatch PLC has provided a letter of comfort in support of Carsons Management Services (Private) Limited
confirming its intention to continue to provide financial and other support and meet liabilities to enable the wholly-owned
subsidiary to continue as a going concern, for audit purposes.
